services.desc: The center is a non-profit and admission is alway free. We offer ticketed events and tours throughout the year to support new exhibits and history center programs. Provided below are upcoming events. April - June & September - October, First Saturday 1-3 pm Climb the 107 steps to the top of the tower for the best views and selfies in Rome. View the interior tower murals that depict Rome's history. Join us if you dare aboard the Roman Rose Trolley as your docent from the dead spins harrowing tales of misfortune, death, and mayhem.
